clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Irene era seduta su una sedia, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Irene was sitting on a chair, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 4ª colonna e accanto a un'ancora.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 4th column and beside an anchor.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a una cuccetta e nella stessa stanza di Nino.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a bunk and in the same room as Nino.

clues.it: Elena era nella 5ª riga e accanto a un'ancora o a una corda.
clues.en: Elena was in the 5th row and beside an anchor or a rope coil.

clues.it: Nino era nella 2ª colonna e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Nino was in the 2nd column and west of Luca.

clues.it: Sergio era a ovest di Nino e in Cabina.
clues.en: Sergio was west of Nino and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una cassa o a una pianta e a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Tea was beside a crate or a plant and a shelf.

clues.it: Luca era nella 6ª colonna, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Luca was in the 6th column, but was not beside a plant.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Elena's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Sergio può stare solo nella 1ª colonna.
steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 1st column.

steps.it: Elena può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Elena can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.it: Elena può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Elena can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 6ª riga: escludendola, a Sergio resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 7th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 persona in Plancia» non torna senza Luca: deve stare in riga 9ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 person on the Bridge” cannot add up without Luca: they must be at row 9th, column 6th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone sul Ponte» non torna senza Dario: deve stare in riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people on the Deck” cannot add up without Dario: they must be at row 1st, column 3rd.
